findings.reason: Wait observing v>0 is not sufficient to register: if final Done changes state to zero before CompareAndSwap, that CAS fails and Wait loops and returns via zero fast-path (waitgroup.go:164-168,184-187).
Done delegates Add(-1), atomic change precedes negative panic, and a subsequent no-intervention Wait attempts to register and acquire semaphore.
Go wrapper defers recover and Done after f; source 236-258 and Goexit semantics support the qualified non-panicking deferred-function case.
The explicit non-nil recovered-value qualification matches waitgroup.go:239-251; domain contract forbids panic.
Add clears state and releases waiters at 123-142; Wait checks state after semaphore acquire at 205-215. Both state observations can occur under stated schedules.
For 64-bit int, uint64(1<<32)<<32 is zero in Go 64-bit arithmetic; Add sees v=0,w=0 and returns, Wait zero path returns. Source comments do not state supported delta width.
